企业时报 / 东方财富Choice — Jul 28 港股收盘
TradingKey — Jul 28 美股收盘 / SOX

marketTone: Value beats AI beta for a second session: Jul 28 Dow +1.03% while SOX −4.49% and Nasdaq slipped; oil fell again (WTI settle $79.26, Brent $84.09) into Wednesday's Fed decision, while China growth indexes sold off hard even as Changxin held ~CNY3.28tn.

summary.text: Jul 28 US close: S&P 500 +0.21% to 7,428.78, Dow +1.03% (537.24 pts) to 52,747.32, Nasdaq −0.22% to 24,876.91; AP said most stocks rose on earnings while chip/AI winners capped gains.
Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 4.49% to 11,035.68; Apple reached a $5tn market-cap headline while memory/optical names extended losses.
WTI settled at $79.26 (−4.0%) and Brent at $84.09 (−4.8%) on Jul 28; 10-year Treasury yield eased to about 4.606% as oil relief met Fed caution.
Jul 28 A股：上证指数 −1.16% 报3813.31点，深证成指 −4.52%，创业板指 −7.35%，科创50 −6.33%；存储/CPO 板块重挫，两市成交约2.03万亿元。
长鑫科技上市次日低开7.71%后回稳，收盘49.00元（+0.06%），总市值约3.28万亿元，仍居A股市值榜首；首日成交1411.87亿元创A股纪录。

sources.label: 企业时报 / 东方财富Choice Jul 28

summary.text: Bitcoin slid about 2.7% and dipped below $63,000 after the US close as Asia risk-off (Kospi −10%) hit crypto beta; liquidations topped $500m in 24h.

signal: Rotation is the tape: oil relief and earnings lift cyclicals, but AI hardware and China growth names are repricing financing/valuation risk ahead of the Fed statement.
watch: Whether the Fed (14:00 ET Wed) validates lower oil as disinflationary without turning more hawkish; watch SOX stabilization, Changxin follow-through vs Shanghai breadth, and Brent staying below $90.
globalRegime: Late-cycle policy sensitivity with sector rotation: energy premium unwinds help duration and value, while AI capex/financing stress and China tech valuation reset dominate downside headlines.

globalChanged.text: 美伊冲突暂停延续，油价连续第三日下跌；CNBC称WTI收于79.26美元、布伦特收于84.09美元，市场聚焦周三美联储决议。
美股分化，道指涨537点、标普微涨，纳指微跌；芯片股再遭抛售，费城半导体指数跌4.49%。
美债收益率走低，10年期约4.606%；CME FedWatch显示市场对按兵不动的定价占优，但9月加息概率仍被关注。
亚太芯片链风险外溢：韩国Kospi单日重挫近11%，SK海力士等大跌，日本存储股同步走弱。
美联储7月29日14:00 ET公布利率决议（无点阵图），主席Warsh 14:30 ET举行新闻发布会。

globalImplies.text: Cheaper oil supports bonds and import-sensitive equities, but the Fed can still spoil the trade if it links energy relief to demand strength.
SOX breaking 11,200 support makes AI hardware the swing factor for Nasdaq breadth into mega-cap earnings.
China risk appetite is bifurcated: mega-cap hard tech liquidity event vs broad growth-index derating.

globalTensions: Dow +1% vs SOX −4.5%; Brent −4.8% vs Fed hawkish-risk debate; HSI green vs ChiNext −7.4%; Changxin flat-close vs 存储 chip sector rout.
chinaStance: Hard-tech self-reliance story is intact, but tradable A-share beta is under pressure: STAR/ChiNext sold off while Hong Kong mega-caps held up.

chinaChanged.text: 长鑫科技次日收49.00元，总市值约3.28万亿元，仍居A股首位；招股书显示合肥国资体系持股33.11%，对应市值约1.09万亿元。
7月28日A股宽基指数全线下跌，创业板指跌7.35%，科创50跌6.33%；白酒、乳业等防御板块相对抗跌。
恒生指数涨0.41%、恒生科技涨0.61%，港股与A股成长线走势分化。
